trans-unit.source: Why do you concern yourself with me?
trans-unit.target: Why do you concern yourself with me?

trans-unit.source: I dunno. Maybe because I had a younger sister about the same age as you.
trans-unit.target: I dunno. Maybe because I had a younger sister about the same age as you.

trans-unit.source: She was an adorable girl named Ami. But she was killed...
trans-unit.target: She was an adorable girl named Ami. But she was killed...

trans-unit.source: I know you're not--that's impossible. I just want you to be able to
trans-unit.target: I know you're not--that's impossible. I just want you to be able to

trans-unit.source: experience and enjoy all the good things in this world, even those Ami could not.
